title: Procurement of furnishing item of New Inspection Quarter at Dariyapur Lighthouse.
summary: Procurement of furnishing items for the new Inspection Quarter at Dariyapur Lighthouse, Purba Medinipur, West Bengal, tendered by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhawan, D-372/2 Taratala Road, Kolkata

sites.name: Dariyapur Lighthouse, Purba Medinapur, West Bengal
sites.work: Furnishing items for new Inspection Quarter

scope.item: Procurement of furnishing items of New Inspection Quarter (no item list in this notice)

money.notes: EMD by Demand Draft/FDR/Bank Guarantee of scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata, valid three months from technical bid opening; exemption not allowed; last date for original EMD 11/09/2024.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration of appropriate class in appropriate category (Building civil work) in Central govt. department/undertaking/autonomous body or State govt.

Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%; similar works = furnishing/interior decoration (wooden furniture manufacturing & installation, false ceiling etc.) of any residential/non-residential building; values updated at 7% per annum
Valid PAN card and GST registration
Notarized affidavit (2024) of not being blacklisted or debarred
Undertaking that price bid is unconditional
Tender acceptance letter on letter pad; other documents as per Section VI
notes: Notice only (pages numbered 3-6); no item list/BOQ. Bid download and submission 21/08/2024 10:00 to 11/09/2024 15:00. Notice says original EMD should reach 'up to 7 days from the date of opening of technical bid' in one place and gives last date 11/09/2024 in the table.
